why: Profit breakout: +88% YoY and above the last 4 quarters
Strong order book: 3.8x annual sales (revenue visibility)
Management outlook: At the last year con call, we had a guidance of 40% revenue growth and 2 % gross margin improvement.
Latest quarter Jun 2026: Excellent (sales +85% YoY, profit +88% YoY)

risks: Working capital stretching - debtor days 90 to 110, inventory days 136 to 110 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up

Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only 21% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

order_book: We now have a very strong order book of INR1,200 plus c rores, which provides us revenue visibility over and above our existing revenue and customers.

guidance: At the last year con call, we had a guidance of 40% revenue growth and 2 % gross margin improvement.

risks: The management may make some forward -looking statements in today's presentation, and this must be understood along with the uncertainty and risk associated with the company and i n general the current scenario.
As the year had uncertainty with tariffs and West Asia conflict, we proactively invested in working capital and built-up inventory to ensure business continuity.
